units.source_text: 且说薰大将收到了那封退回的信之后，并不答复，匆匆过了数日。

en.t: After Captain Kaoru received the returned letter, he sent no reply, and several days quickly passed.

units.source_text: 有一天，那个威势十足的内舍人到山庄来了。

en.t: One day, that imposing palace attendant came to the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 果如右近所说，其人非常粗蛮，是个体格魁梧的老人，声音嘶嗄，说起话来语调异乎常人。

en.t: Just as Ukon had said, he was extremely rough, a large-framed old man with a hoarse voice and an unusually strange way of speaking.

units.source_text: 他叫人传言：“有话要对侍女谈。”

en.t: He had someone send in a message: "I have something to discuss with the lady's attendant."

units.source_text: 右近就出来接见。

en.t: Ukon came out to receive him.

units.source_text: 他说：“我蒙大将宣召，今日入京参见，此刻方才回来。

en.t: He said, "I was summoned by the Captain, went to the capital today to attend him, and have only just returned.

units.source_text: 大将吩咐种种杂务，其中说起一事：

en.t: The Captain gave me various errands, and among them he brought up one matter:

units.source_text: 近有一位小姐住在这里，夜间警卫之事，因有我等担当，故京中不曾特派值宿人来此。

en.t: Lately a young lady has been staying here, and since we are responsible for the night guard, no special night attendants have been sent from the capital.

units.source_text: 但据悉近有来历不明之男子常与此间侍女往还。

en.t: But he has heard that recently a man of unknown background has often been coming and going among the attendants here.

units.source_text: 大将责问我，他说：‘此事实太疏忽。

en.t: The Captain questioned me harshly, saying, 'This is far too careless.

units.source_text: 守夜人应该查明情况。怎么你们会不知道呢？’

en.t: The night guards should have looked into the matter. How could you all not know about it?'

units.source_text: 但我并未闻知此事，便禀告大将：‘某因身患重病，久未担任守夜之事，其实不悉此种情况。

en.t: But I had heard nothing of it, so I reported to the Captain, 'Because I have been seriously ill, I have not taken night duty for a long time, and in truth I know nothing of such circumstances.

units.source_text: 但曾派定干练男子，令其轮流守夜，不得懈怠。

en.t: However, I did appoint capable men and ordered them to take turns on night watch without negligence.

units.source_text: 若果有此等非常事件发生，何以某迄未闻知？’

en.t: If such an extraordinary incident had truly occurred, how could I still not have heard of it?'

units.source_text: 大将言道：‘今后必须小心在意！如果发生荒谬之事，定当严予惩办！’

en.t: The Captain said, 'From now on you must be very careful. If anything outrageous happens, I will punish it severely.'

units.source_text: 不知大将为什么说这种话，我实不胜惶恐。”

en.t: I do not know why the Captain said such things, and I am truly filled with fear."

units.source_text: 右近听了这话，比听到猫头鹰叫更觉恐怖，一句话也回答不出。

en.t: When Ukon heard this, she felt more terrified than if she had heard an owl cry, and could not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 她回进里面，传达了内舍人的话，叹道：

en.t: She went back inside, relayed the palace attendant's words, and sighed:

units.source_text: “请听他的话！和我所预料的一点也不差！

en.t: "Listen to what he said! It is exactly what I expected, not different in the slightest.

units.source_text: 多分大将已经听到风声了。信也不写一封来。”

en.t: The Captain has probably already heard the rumors. He has not even sent a single letter."

units.source_text: 乳母约略听到这些话，说道：

en.t: The nurse caught the gist of these words and said:

units.source_text: “大将如此吩咐，我听了真高兴！

en.t: "I am truly glad to hear that the Captain gave such orders.

units.source_text: 这一带地方盗贼很多，那些值夜人不像从前那样认真，

en.t: There are many thieves in this area, and those night attendants are no longer as conscientious as they used to be.

units.source_text: 都找一些吊儿郎当的下司来代理，连巡夜也没有了。”

en.t: They all find some careless lower servants to stand in for them, and they do not even make night rounds anymore."

units.source_text: 她说时喜形于色。

en.t: As she spoke, joy showed plainly on her face.
